transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve just been feeling like I’ve messed things up for my family. Taking on the mortgage, and then every little mistake I make at work feels like proof that I’m useless. Like maybe I deserve whatever comes from it.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to joke around with the regulars at work, text my brother after shifts, stuff like that. Lately I just kind of… keep my face straight, say what I need to say, and leave messages sitting there. I don’t really feel like answering.
Have you stopped doing things that you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy or relax?

Yeah… kind of. I don’t really joke with the regulars anymore, even when they try. After work I used to text my brother, just to unwind, but now I mostly let the messages sit there. I just don’t feel much push to do it.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or like you're a burden to others, even when you haven't done anything particularly wrong?

Yeah… I do. Mostly with my family. I keep thinking I shouldn’t have taken on the mortgage, like I’ve put everyone in a bad spot. And then if I make some little mistake at work, it just feels like… there it is, proof I’m useless. Like I deserve whatever happens after that.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. It’s not always loud or anything. Just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I’m at work carrying plates, smiling because I’m supposed to, but… I don’t really feel much good in it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been going on for weeks, months, or longer?
It’s been… a while. About a year, I guess. Maybe a little more—like a year and a couple months that it’s been coming around like this.
Do you feel down or hopeless most days, even when nothing particularly bad has happened?

Yeah… most days. Even if nothing really happened, it’s just this heavy, empty feeling. I’m kind of just going through the motions at work, carrying plates, smiling because I have to… not because I feel good.
Have you had times in the past when you felt this way before, or is this the first time you've felt this depressed?

I mean… I’ve had rough patches before, I guess, but this one’s been the main thing. It’s been going on about a year and two months now. The depressed, guilty feeling… it’s been around most of that time.
Have you ever had a previous period of depression that lasted for two years or more?
I don’t think so… not two years straight. I’ve had bad stretches, but I’m not really sure about anything that long.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt depressed for at least a couple of weeks at a time, even if it wasn’t as long as this current one?

Yeah… I think so. I’ve had times where that heavy, empty feeling was there most days, just kind of moving through work and smiling because I had to. I don’t really remember exactly how long, but… at least a couple weeks, probably.
Can you recall if any of those past depressed periods lasted for several weeks or even a couple of months, but not as long as this current episode?

Yeah… maybe several weeks. I don’t know about a couple months. It was more like most days I’d have that heavy, empty feeling in my chest, just… working, carrying plates, smiling because I had to. Not really feeling much good.
Can you remember if any of your past low periods lasted for at least two weeks, where most days you felt down, empty, or like you had to force yourself through work and daily activities?

Yeah… I think so. At least a couple weeks, probably. Most days it was that heavy, empty feeling, like I was just getting through shifts, carrying plates and smiling because I had to. Not really because I felt okay.
Can you remember if your low mood has been present most of the time for at least 2 years, even if it wasn’t as severe as it is now?
Not two years, no… more like a year and eight months, I guess. Since after I took on the condo mortgage, it’s been there most of the time.
